newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Midopa, Dainong fall at open.
newsitem.headline: Midopa, Dainong fall at open.

text.p: Shares in both Midopa Department Store Co and Dainong Corp fell to their daily limits at the opening on Tuesday due to worries over their financial troubles, brokers said.
Midopa was down 650 won to 7,490 and Dainong fell 250 won to 2,930. Trading in the shares resumed on Tuesday after a half-day suspension on Monday afternoon.
The two are among the four core units of the financially troubled Dainong Group, which was tapped on Monday to be bailed out under a scheme drawn up last month by the nation's commercial banks.
The group's main creditor SEOULBANK said on Monday it would bail out the four companies by keeping their credit lines open even after they default on debt repayments.
The scheme was aimed at preventing promising companies from going insolvent under debts.
